resources.string: Detects user-selected distracting app launches during active Focus Sessions (no screen content read).

RegainFocus uses this service solely with your explicit consent to detect the foreground app package name when you open an app you chose to restrict during a Focus Session or Daily App Limit, and to show your Focus Timer Shield. RegainFocus has canRetrieveWindowContent disabled, never reads screen text, messages, passwords, or personal data, and has zero internet access.
